judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime validation and schema caching in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, but the run terminated before finishing the final facet in its own `.lore/dod.md`. Consequently, several explicit acceptance criteria are completely missing: updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, as well as tests for extra properties passing through unchanged, `Unknown tool: <name>` throwing, and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Furthermore, the candidate got sidetracked into over-engineered legacy Ajv v6 `dataPath` normalization (likely due to Jest resolving ESLint's transitive Ajv v6 instead of v8 when default-importing `Ajv` instead of `{Ajv}`), resulting in bloated error formatting logic and three separate test files (`registry.test.ts`, `registry.acceptance.test.ts`, `registry.round.test.ts`). Finally, it leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and writes a fragmented `CHANGELOG.md` entry missing the primary feature description and migration note.
